# Arugula Motors

> Arugula Motors builds custom websites, software, and dashboards for local businesses in Charleston, South Carolina. You own what we build, instead of renting it from a SaaS company.

Founded and run by Kevin in Charleston, SC. He builds the software and stands behind every project personally. The main way to get in touch is to book a call, linked from https://www.arugulamotors.com.

## Products

- Custom websites: Websites for local businesses, built to fit the business they are for and easy to update. You own what we build, instead of renting a template platform every month. Pricing on request.
- Booking sites: Take reservations and bookings directly on your own site, so you keep the cut that Airbnb, VRBO, and the big platforms take. Pricing on request.
- [White Bread](https://www.arugulamotors.com/white-bread/): A point of sale system for pizza, sandwich, and counter shops. You pay once and own it, including the source code, instead of renting Toast per terminal. Price: $22,000 for a single shop build.
- [Mic](https://www.arugulamotors.com/mic/): Helps a local business run its own podcast and actually keep it going, episode after episode, to build a regular audience. Audio only, done with you or done for you. Pricing on request.
- [Pigeon](https://www.arugulamotors.com/pigeon/): A newsletter that actually goes out. Pigeon is the engine that sends your newsletter every day on its own, with no expensive monthly platform and no vendor who owns your list. You own it. Done with you or done for you. We run one on Pigeon ourselves, the heist (https://heist.arugulamotors.com), a daily art newsletter that has gone out every morning. Pricing on request.
- [Broom](https://www.arugulamotors.com/broom/): Cleaning and turnover software for short-term rental operators. You own it, instead of renting Turno, Properly, or Breezeway. Price: $12,000 for up to 25 properties.

## On the bench (built on request)

- Diary: bookings and reservations
- Tab: loyalty and punch cards
- Plot: staff scheduling

## Pricing

Fixed prices, quoted up front, at https://www.arugulamotors.com/pricing/.

- Site tune-up: from $1,500. Speed and mobile fixes, working forms, SSL, and a copy cleanup on your current site.
- Full rebuild: from $4,000, scaling with the number of pages. A brand new custom site, built to fit your business and yours to own.
- Care plan: $150 a month. Ongoing updates, small changes, and hosting. Cancel anytime.

## More

- [Work](https://www.arugulamotors.com/work/): A few things we have built, in production. Includes four country websites rebuilt in-house for a $500M advisory firm, ordering and kitchen apps for a food business, and a direct-booking rental site with no platform fees.
- [About](https://www.arugulamotors.com/about/): Who is behind Arugula Motors, and answers to common questions.

## How Arugula Motors is different

- You own what we build. Source code and full ownership on delivery, no subscriptions, no per terminal fees, no lock-in.
- Local to Charleston, South Carolina. Works with Lowcountry businesses in person and on software projects remotely.
- Founder led and hands on, so feedback turns into fixes the same day.
